content: The life of man is a self-evolving circle, which, from a ring imperceptibly small, rushes on all sides outwards to new and larger circles.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Consciousness expands through continual self-transcendence. As soon as you master one sphere of capability, reality summons you to expand outward again.
practicalInsight: Take on a challenge that sits slightly outside your current comfort zone to expand your sphere of mastery.
reflectionPrompt: In what direction is life urging you to expand your circle today?
